intent: Choose one value from a bounded set using the platform's native selector.

context.override: Only explicitly selected axes change; unrelated axes remain inherited.

invariants: Native name, value, disabled state and keyboard semantics survive decoration
Icon slots remain square, centered and pointer-transparent
Selected text has reserved space for both decorative slots
limits: Native popup appearance and placement belong to the browser/OS
No custom listbox behavior is implied
Shadow roots require their own styles and authored anatomy.

labelColor.override: Local exported family semantic text role; selected value keeps its own foreground

construction.preferred: Authored .select__root wrapper, native select and aria-hidden indicator slot with local Phosphor SVG; no JavaScript required for presentation or selection.
construction.application: Navigation, persistence and responses to selection remain consuming-page behavior.
construction.buildTime: Artifact builder compiles bare selects and bundled icon shorthands before delivery; existing canonical wrappers are preserved. Dynamic application markup must supply complete anatomy or call createSelectControl from assets/control-markup.mjs explicitly. Build-time leading-icon shorthand is data-select-icon.
construction.openIndicator: CSS select:open rotates the indicator 180deg while the native picker is open. Focus alone does not imply open. Engines without reflected :open retain a downward caret; no guessed JS open state.

implementation.anatomy: Canonical select__root anatomy is defined by construction.preferred and the linked recipe.
implementation.native: The actual select owns name/value/options, selection keyboard behavior and disabled state; native popup paint/placement remains platform-owned.
implementation.javascript: No presentation or selection initializer. See construction.application for consuming-page behavior and construction.buildTime for explicit dynamic construction.
implementation.fallback: The ordinary native select remains the semantic fallback. Missing custom decoration must not remove it; rich combobox behavior is outside this contract.

evidence.scope: Authored native recipe and keyboard/script-disabled paths on these engine versions; older engines, installed Safari and assistive technology are unverified.

indicatorOwnership: compileControls owns the trailing caret. data-select-icon supplies a leading semantic icon, not the indicator; omit it when no semantic icon is needed. A leading caret-down duplicates the owned indicator.

contentFit.rule: Use explicit, distinct concise optionLabel values; retain stable record IDs as values and show full selected title in adjacent wrapping detail. Never mechanically slice titles or rely on tooltips. If meaningful labels cannot fit, choose a wrapping record chooser instead.
contentFit.check: SELECT_TEXT_FIT measures every option against the closed native control content width; enlarged text and every dynamic set matter. Popup rendering remains OS-owned.
contentFit.composition: Optional record-picker__root on the owning field__root bounds a concise record selector to36ch, capped by available width. Full titles remain in wrapping detail.

indicatorContainment: The decorative indicator stays inside the visible native select frame at all widths and text sizes. Size select__root/select__root; retain the maintained child select width:100%. A width:auto child inside a wider positioned wrapper can strand the caret beyond its border. Verify SELECT_INDICATOR_BOUNDS, SELECT_ANATOMY and SELECT_TEXT_FIT on the compiled artifact, including narrow widths, enlarged text and dynamic options.

prefix.ownership: Compiler adds decorative select__prefix inside the single maintained wrapper. Accessible name remains explicit. Wrapper owns border and focus; no toolbar-specific select implementation.
prefix.geometry: Standard control geometry and text; prefix padding uses shared text edge, value gap d/2. Caller sizes wrapper; select retains flexible width.
prefix.semantics: Native platform options are intentional for native-select; custom listboxes remain a separate pattern.

appearance.ghost: Transparent resting border/background; same geometry, prefix and focus owner; shared paired hover colors.
